title: Correctness of the feedforward embedding
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables, and let $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \bbf_2$ be an assignment of Boolean values to those variables. Form the feedforward embedding of $C$, a layered feedforward circuit with a single output wire, and let its unique output value under $x$ be the Boolean it computes. Then this value equals $C(x)$, the value obtained by evaluating the circuit $C$ directly on the assignment $x$.
hypotheses_covered: a Boolean circuit C on n variables
a Boolean assignment x to the n variables
replaced:
For every circuit $C$ on $n$ inputs and every input $x$,
$C.\texttt{toFeedForward}.\texttt{eval}_1\ x = C.\texttt{eval}\ x$.
